description:
[Game reference] Daily apartment rent for a room size and what you keep in it. The game's formula: `max(minimum rent, sum(tax per stack x amount / stack size) x apartment.rentscaling)` scrap per
real day, taken continuously from the room's upkeep terminal; evicted after `eviction_after_s` unpaid. Vanilla apartment.rentscaling is 0, so rent is the room's minimum unless the server raised it. Link https://rust.wiki/apartments.

items.description: Comma-separated `shortname:amount` you store in the room or carry nearby, e.g. `sulfur:5000,metal.fragments:10000`.

name: calculate_apartment_rent
title: Daily apartment rent for a room size and what you keep in it
